answer: Charge a quadratic creation fee for each new identity a funder registers: the first costs one unit, the second four, the third nine, and so on, with every fee burned, not refunded. A lone agent crossing the ocean of the network pays a single coin and writes its name with one quill stroke. A farm must pay the square of its size, so a thousand fakes cost a fortune while each fake still earns only one share - the ember of profit dies under the weight of the fee itself.
